column1: # Manual New-Plans pins — force-show a plan as ↻ Changed for a fixed window.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
# The New Plans "changed" pass (src/plan_changes.py) diffs a plan's attributes
# against a committed snapshot. Two things can make it MISS a real change:
#   1. the snapshot was re-taken AFTER the patch built, so the new source got
#      baked into the baseline and the diff sees no difference; and
#   2. the coherence gate holds a route-add when a dependency export
#      (COBJ / LVLI / CONT) is older than the BOOK export.
# Either way a plan that genuinely gained a source this patch never gets the
# ↻ Changed pill. This file is the manual override: list the plan, the source
# it gained, and a start/end window, and the pipeline force-shows it as changed
# until the end date passes — then it drops off on its own, no edit needed.
# It is READ GENERATIVELY by src/plan_pins.py during the plan_master re-enrich
# (reenrich_plan_master.py). It never touches dist JSON by hand. A pin only
# fires while  StartDate <= today <= EndDate ; outside that window it is inert.
# A pin whose Route the diff has since detected on its own is de-duped, so it is
# safe to leave a pin in place until its end date even after the export catches
# up.
# COLUMNS (tab-separated)
#   PlanId     plan_master item id, e.g. PLAN_00620A54  (== "PLAN_" + BOOK FormID)
#   Kind       route-added | route-removed | tradeable | stops-dropping | cut
#   Route      for route-added/removed: the exact obtain_routes[].route string.
#              (blank for the scalar kinds)
#   Bucket     for route-added/removed: the obtain-ledger label, e.g.
#              "Events & Activities". (blank for the scalar kinds)
#   StartDate  D/M/YYYY — first day the pin is live (matches fallout76_seasons.tsv)
#   EndDate    D/M/YYYY — last day the pin is live; after this it stops showing
#   Channel    live | pts | both  — which channel(s) the pin applies to. Blank =
#              live. These SDOW plans are already in the LIVE game, so pinning
#              them "live" keeps them off the PTS "what's coming next" page.
#   Note       free text for maintainers; never rendered
# THE SLASHER / SDOW PINS (added 22 Sep 2026)
# 7 pre-existing plans were added to the new SDOW / "The Slasher" mini-season
# loot in the 15 Sep 2026 patch but were swallowed by both causes above. End
# date = 1/12/2026 = the S26 "Beware the Blood Moon" SEASON end. The Slasher
# SEASONAL EVENT's own window is a PLACEHOLDER in src/home/events.tsv (Bethesda
# has not stated it), so per the season-end fallback rule the season end is used.
# If Bethesda confirms a shorter Slasher window, shorten EndDate to match.
